claim: The Sagrada Família reached its peak height of 172.5 metres on 20 February 2026 when a 17-metre cross was placed atop the Tower of Jesus Christ.
quote: The Tower of Jesus Christ, which now stands at 172.5 meters above the city, is one of the 18 towers originally conceived by Gaudí.

claim: The Sagrada Família became the world's tallest church in October 2025, surpassing Germany's Ulm Minster.
quote: The Sagrada Família already became the world's tallest church last October after another part of its central tower was lifted into place, rising above the spire of Germany's Ulm Minster

claim: An independent Catalan news outlet confirms the basilica reached its final height of 172.5 metres as the cross was installed atop the Tower of Jesus on 20 February 2026, the world's tallest church.
quote: Sagrada Família reaches final height of 172.5 metres as cross is installed atop Tower of Jesus

claim: Metro line L9 Sud takes an estimated 32 minutes from Barcelona-El Prat airport (T1) to Zona Universitaria, where it joins the central metro network, running every 7 minutes.
quote: The estimated travel time is 32 minutes from the Zona Universitaria station to the last stop at T1; commercial speed of the train is 37 km per hour.
